primitives.purpose: The Cloudflare Worker entry of apps/agent and the Edge. The Edge accepts the Telegram webhook with its secret token, finds the Owner through the Directory, and answers only after the Personal Agent stores the Event. It records a metric for each refused request. It also has the Operator route that adds an Owner. It stores no Owner data.

The Directory in D1 with its Drizzle schema and migrations: Owners, Channel Identities, and the Registration state. Its interface finds the Owner for a Channel Identity, adds an Owner with a Channel Identity, and reads the Registration state. No other module runs SQL against the Directory.

One Durable Object for each Owner, built on the pinned Agents SDK. personalAgentFor finds it by Owner Id. Each object builds one Effect runtime over its SQLite storage. It stores each Event in the Inbox, schedules the Turn with a durable alarm, and runs the Turn: model reply, Journal Entries, and the Channel send. A tool with a side effect saves its call and result in the same transaction as its write, so a Turn that restarts replays them and does not run the tool again. It writes the conversation of each Event once, and Journal recovery finishes a write that a reset cut off. It owns the Drizzle storage schema and the versioned migrations that each Personal Agent applies once, in order, when it starts.
The Owner message Event that a Channel gives to the Personal Agent.
The append-only Journal in the Personal Agent SQLite. The interface has append, read, and read for one Event, with no update or delete, and storage triggers refuse updates and deletes.

The Document primitive (Notes). A Note has a Note id, Owner Id, text, optional URL, source (Event and Channel message), trust level (owner or untrusted), captured date, and last-checked date. It lives in the Personal Agent SQLite. The capture_note tool writes a Note; code sets the source and the trust level from the Event, not the model. A unique constraint on the source Event id and the hash of the normalized text at capture (an edit keeps it) makes a repeated write return the existing Note. Each Note write appends a Journal Entry with the Note id. An FTS5 table over the Note text and URL (versioned migration, triggers keep it in step with the notes table in the same transaction) ranks matches by bm25. A note_links table (from Note, to Note, created date; the pair is stored in id order, so a link is undirected) links related Notes. The capture_note tool takes optional Note ids to link; code rejects an id that is not a Note of the Owner, and the tool returns an error and writes nothing. The update_note tool changes the text or the links of one Note, sets its last-checked date, and appends a NoteUpdated Journal Entry with the Note id and the kind of change (text, links, or text_and_links); the FTS5 table stays in step through its triggers. The search_notes tool takes a query and a limit and returns Note id, text, URL, source, trust level, captured date, last-checked date, and, for each match, its five newest linked Notes (ordered by the date of the link, each with Note id, text, URL, source, trust level, and captured date) and the total count of its links. The list_linked_notes tool takes a Note id and an offset and returns the next five linked Notes of that Note, newest link first, with the total count, so older context stays reachable; text of an untrusted Note is marked as Untrusted Content. The system prompt asks for the source and the date in each answer and for an honest "I do not know" when no Note matches. The agent does not fetch links.

The Profile primitive: the short core facts and style rules about the Owner, in the profile_entries table of the Personal Agent SQLite (versioned migration). An entry has an entry id, a kind (fact or style_rule), text, the source Event id, and the added date; the same kind and text is stored once. The update_profile tool adds or removes one entry; code, not the model, checks the hard size limit (maxProfileCharacters of the Behavior Config, counted as the characters of all entry texts). An add that would pass the limit writes nothing and returns an error result, and the system prompt tells the agent to tell the Owner. A remove of an unknown entry id returns an error and writes nothing. Every Turn reads the whole Profile and puts it, with the entry ids, in the system prompt, so the Trace holds it. Each change appends a ProfileEntryAdded (entry id and kind) or ProfileEntryRemoved (entry id) Journal Entry, and the tool call is in the Trace. The recall rule of the system prompt answers from the Profile first and searches Notes only when the Profile has no answer.

The one interface to models. It selects the model for a task, resolves the Model Credentials (token and billing mode), calls it with the AI SDK through Cloudflare AI Gateway with the Owner Id as metadata and no stored bodies, retries with a timeout for each try, and records Usage for each model call in the Personal Agent SQLite.

The Trace and the Operator metrics of a Turn. The Trace is one append-only record for each model-answered Event in the Personal Agent SQLite: the system prompt, the messages, the model settings, tool calls, the reply or the error, Usage, and latency. That is enough to replay the Turn, and it holds private content, so it stays with the Owner. The Operator metrics are one Analytics Engine data point for each Turn and each refused request, with the Owner Id (or none), result, latency, tokens, cost, and cache hits, and with no content. The Redactor removes secret values from error text before it enters a Trace or the Journal.

The Channel send action and the Telegram Channel: it decodes private text messages from Telegram updates and sends a plain-text reply that links to the Owner's message, split into parts within the Telegram limit of 4,096 characters. A send is confirmed only with a Telegram message id.
The typed Behavior Config defaults: the texting style, the tool step limit of a Turn, and the size limit of the Profile in characters.
The branded Owner Id schema. Every Owner-scoped resource uses it as its key.

The control CLI of apps/agent: doctor checks configuration and secret names, dev runs the Worker locally with local fakes, owner add adds the Owner through the Operator route, request --contains proves a reply locally with no network, map writes and checks the Feature Map of the Edge routes, and bundle measures bundle size and local startup CPU.
